predictions.heading: GOG to win at TMS Ringsted

sources.label: Betoro Herreligaen table (tophaandbold.dk, Danish Handball Federation)

predictions.text: GOG arrive with the stronger record of these two: three wins and a draw from five Champions League group matches, scoring 35.6 goals a game and conceding 34.4. TMS Ringsted's Danish league season reads one win, one draw and eight defeats in ten, with 30.6 scored and 34.2 conceded per game. It is a cross-competition comparison, so the gap is not exact, but the direction is clear. Selection: GOG to win the moneyline at -278.

predictions.heading: Veszprém to win at Porto
predictions.text: Porto's group phase has one win, one draw and three defeats, and they concede 34.6 goals a match while scoring 31.6. Veszprém have won all five, scoring 37 and conceding 29.2. Home advantage is in the price, but the visitors' defensive record is five goals a game better than Porto's and their attack is the strongest in Group A. Selection: One Veszprém HC moneyline at -294.

predictions.event_name: SC Magdeburg vs HC Kriens Luzern
predictions.heading: Magdeburg to win at home
predictions.text: SC Magdeburg are five from five in Champions League Group F, scoring 35.2 goals a match and conceding 28. HC Kriens-Luzern are two wins and three defeats, scoring 31.6 and conceding 32.2. Magdeburg's goal difference is the better of the two by a wide margin and they score 35.2 goals a game against Kriens' 31.6. The price is short because the gap is real. Selection: SC Magdeburg moneyline at -556.

predictions.heading: Kielce to win at home
predictions.text: Industria Kielce have three wins from five in Group F, scoring 31 goals a game and conceding 30.6. Kolstad have lost all five, scoring 28.6 and conceding 35.6, the widest negative differential of the two at -35 across the group phase. Kielce are at home, and the line treats Kolstad's defensive record as the dominant factor. Selection: Industria Kielce moneyline at -556.

predictions.heading: Füchse Berlin to win at home
predictions.text: Partizan have one point from five rounds, a draw and four defeats, with 29.6 scored and 36.8 conceded. Füchse Berlin sit on three wins from five, 36.8 scored and 34.4 conceded. Berlin's advantage is in attack rather than defence, and home court adds to it; the Serbians have not won a match in the group. Selection: Füchse Berlin moneyline at -435.

predictions.heading: Edmonton to beat Toronto
predictions.text: Edmonton are 8-1-1 and have won three straight, scoring 4.7 goals a game and conceding 3.2. They are 3-1-1 at Rogers Place and 5-0-0 on the road. Toronto are 6-4-2 with 43 goals for and 39 against and have also won their last three. Both teams are in form, but Edmonton's scoring rate is more than a goal per game higher and their point percentage is .850. Selection: Edmonton Oilers moneyline at -263.

predictions.heading: Boston to beat San Jose
predictions.text: Boston are 8-2-1 with 42 goals for and only 22 against, the best defensive record in this slate, and they are 4-1-0 at TD Garden. San Jose are 6-4-1, scoring 3.0 goals a game and conceding 3.36. The Bruins' plus-20 goal difference over eleven games is built on conceding 2.0 per match, and the line prices that defensive edge alongside home ice. Selection: Boston Bruins moneyline at -213.

predictions.heading: Minnesota to win in Vancouver
predictions.text: Vancouver are 2-9-1 and have lost three in a row, conceding 4.67 goals a game while scoring 2.92, and they are 1-4-0 at Rogers Arena. Minnesota are 6-3-2, scoring 2.91 and conceding 2.45, though only 2-3-2 on the road. That road record is the caveat, yet Vancouver's minus-21 goal difference over twelve games is the worst in this slate. Selection: Minnesota Wild moneyline at -213.

predictions.heading: Seattle to beat Minnesota
predictions.text: Seattle are 7-3-1, scoring four goals a game and conceding 3.36, with a 3-1-0 home record and wins in their last two. Minnesota arrive having lost their most recent game and are 2-3-2 on the road despite a 6-3-2 record overall. Seattle's scoring rate is more than a goal per game better, and home ice separates two teams whose defensive numbers are close. Selection: Seattle Kraken moneyline at -149.

predictions.heading: Washington to beat Buffalo
predictions.text: Washington are 5-4-0, scoring 3.33 goals a game and conceding 3.22, and they are 4-1-0 at Capital One Arena. Buffalo are 4-4-2, scoring 2.8 and conceding 3.7, with a minus-9 goal difference over ten games and defeats in two of their last three. Home ice plus Buffalo's 3.7 goals conceded per game drives the line. Selection: Washington Capitals moneyline at -149.

predictions.heading: Milwaukee to beat Tampa Bay
predictions.text: The Brewers finished 103-59 with a plus-214 run differential, scoring 832 runs and allowing 618, and they are 55-26 at American Family Field. Tampa Bay went 98-64 with a plus-86 differential and are 43-38 on the road, and they have lost their last game while Milwaukee have won five straight. Logan Henderson is scheduled for Milwaukee against Drew Rasmussen. Selection: Milwaukee Brewers moneyline at -135.

predictions.heading: Fernandez to beat Rybakina
predictions.text: Leylah Fernandez is ranked 24th and Elena Rybakina 27th in the WTA singles list captured for this week, three places apart, so our line is close to even. Both are inside the top 30 and the ranking gap is the only official input available for this WTA match, which is why the price offers no meaningful edge either way. Selection: Leylah Fernandez to win the match at -104.
